Three of the four local scripts re-took cleanly on the new source. This one does not, for a reason outside the page.

failingCheck.theOtherEighteen: passed, including the nine registrations, the seven dispatches, both refusals, the staged release and the absent confirm tool

cause.what: a Chromium extension force-installed on this machine, not a request the page made
cause.where: /usr/share/chromium/extensions/cimiefiiaegbelhefglklhhakcgmhkai.json, whose whole content is an external_update_url pointing at clients2.google.com
cause.how: the harness starts Chromium on a fresh temporary profile; an external extension declared system-wide is installed into that profile and injects page-script.js into the http:// origin, and the check counts every requestWillBeSent whose origin is not the page's
cause.notThePage: the page's own request count is unchanged and its CSP still carries connect-src 'none'; the injected URL is a chrome-extension:// script, not an outbound network call by the page
cause.notWorkedAround: the harness's browser flags live in scripts/, and the source tree is frozen for this release, so no flag was added to suppress the extension
